about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A41: sheet-pan, air-fryer, slow-cooker, date night and cooking-for-one dinners.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken Thighs with Potatoes and Broccoli
recipes.summary: Crisp-skinned chicken thighs roast over lemony potatoes, with broccoli added near the end, all on one tray.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potato with half the oil, half the lemon juice, the oregano and half the salt on a large tray.
Rub the chicken with the remaining oil, lemon zest, garlic, remaining salt and pepper and nestle it skin-side up among the potatoes.
Roast for 30 minutes, then add the broccoli and remaining lemon juice and roast for 15 minutes more, until the chicken skin is crisp and the juices run clear.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink and clear juices; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Sausages with Capsicum, Onion and Gnocchi
recipes.summary: Pork sausages, sweet capsicum and shop-bought gnocchi crisp up together on one tray with a little Italian seasoning.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the gnocchi, capsicum, onion, oil, seasoning and salt together on a large tray.
Nestle the sausages among the vegetables and roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until the sausages are browned and cooked through and the gnocchi is golden.
Scatter with parsley and serve from the tray.
notes: Food safety: pork sausages must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Salmon with Asparagus and Baby Potatoes
recipes.summary: Salmon fillets and asparagus finish on a tray of roasted baby potatoes with lemon and dill.
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (190°C fan). Toss the potatoes with half the oil and half the salt on a tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the asparagus and salmon, drizzle with the remaining oil, season and top with lemon slices.
Roast for 10 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily and the asparagus is tender, then scatter with dill.
notes: Food safety: cook the salmon until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C; eat leftovers cold within 1 day.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Harissa Chicken with Chickpeas and Carrots
recipes.summary: Harissa-rubbed chicken thighs roast on a bed of chickpeas and carrots that soak up the juices.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Mix the harissa, half the oil, cumin and half the salt and rub it over the chicken.
Toss the chickpeas, carrots and onion with the remaining oil and salt on a large tray and nestle the chicken on top.
Roast for 40 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the carrots are tender. Serve with yoghurt and coriander.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Miso Tofu with Broccoli and Sweet Potato
recipes.summary: Firm tofu, sweet potato and broccoli roast with a savoury miso glaze for an easy plant-based tray.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Whisk the miso, soy sauce, maple syrup and half the sesame oil until smooth.
Toss the sweet potato with the remaining oil on a tray and roast for 15 minutes, then add the tofu and broccoli and brush with the glaze.
Roast for 20 minutes more, until the tofu is golden and the sweet potato is tender. Serve over rice with sesame seeds and spring onion.
notes: Contains soy, sesame and gluten.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Crumbed Chicken Schnitzel with Crunchy Slaw
recipes.summary: Golden schnitzels cooked in the air fryer with barely any oil, served with a lemony cabbage slaw.
steps: Flatten the chicken to 1 cm. Dip each piece in flour, then egg, then panko mixed with the oil, salt and pepper.
Air-fry at 190°C for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Toss the cabbage, carrot, mayonnaise and lemon juice together and serve alongside the schnitzel.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; wash hands and board after handling raw chicken and egg, and eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Salmon with Honey Soy Glaze and Greens
recipes.summary: Salmon fillets cook in about 10 minutes in the air fryer, then get a sticky honey soy glaze.
steps: Mix the honey, soy sauce, ginger and garlic. Brush half over the salmon.
Air-fry the salmon at 200°C for 8 to 10 minutes, until the fish flakes, adding the bok choy tossed in the sesame oil for the last 4 minutes.
Brush with the remaining glaze and serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the salmon until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C; eat leftovers cold within 1 day.
Contains soy, fish and sesame.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Lamb Koftas with Tzatziki and Flatbread
recipes.summary: Spiced lamb koftas cook through in the air fryer and go straight into warm flatbread with cool tzatziki.
steps: Mix the lamb, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, salt and parsley well and shape into 12 oval koftas.
Air-fry at 190°C for 12 minutes, turning once, until browned and cooked through.
Stir the cucumber into the yoghurt, warm the flatbreads and serve the koftas with tzatziki and tomato.
notes: Food safety: minced lamb must reach 75°C in the centre of a kofta with no pink; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Chicken Drumsticks with Smoky Corn
recipes.summary: Smoked paprika drumsticks cook up crisp in the air fryer, with corn cobs and a squeeze of lime.
steps: Toss the drumsticks with half the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Air-fry at 190°C for 25 minutes, turning halfway, until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear. Rest for 3 minutes.
Rub the corn with the remaining oil and air-fry at 200°C for 8 to 10 minutes until charred, then toss with butter and serve with lime.
notes: Food safety: drumsticks must reach 75°C at the bone with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Crispy Tofu with Peanut Sauce and Rice
recipes.summary: Cornflour-dusted tofu crisps in the air fryer and is tossed in a quick peanut sauce.
steps: Toss the tofu with the cornflour and oil, then air-fry at 200°C for 15 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp and golden.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, maple syrup, chilli and 3 tbsp warm water until smooth.
Toss the tofu in half the sauce and serve over rice with cucumber and the rest of the sauce.
notes: Contains peanuts, soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Stuffed Capsicums with Beef and Rice
recipes.summary: Capsicums filled with beef mince, rice and tomato bake in the air fryer under melted cheese.

items: 4 red capsicum, tops cut off and deseeded

steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, add the mince, cumin, paprika and salt and cook for 6 minutes until browned. Stir in the rice and passata.
Fill the capsicums, stand them upright in the basket and top with cheese.
Air-fry at 180°C for 15 minutes, until the capsicums are tender and the cheese is bubbling.
notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Beef Stew with Dark Ale and Creamy Mash
recipes.summary: Chuck steak simmers all day in dark ale with carrots and onion until fork-tender, served over mash.
steps: Toss the beef in the flour and brown it in the oil in batches for 6 minutes, until deeply coloured, then tip into the slow cooker.
Add the onion, carrot, garlic, ale, stock, tomato paste, thyme and salt. Cook on low for 8 hours, until the beef is fork-tender.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until soft, drain and mash with the butter and milk. Serve the stew over the mash.
notes: Food safety: braise beef to well above 75°C, until fork-tender; cool leftovers quickly and eat within 3 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Butter Chicken with Basmati
recipes.summary: Chicken thigh simmers gently in a creamy tomato and spice sauce while you get on with your day.
steps: Put the chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, spices, tomatoes, butter and salt into the slow cooker and stir. Cook on low for 5 hours, until the chicken is very tender.
Stir in the cream and cook for 10 minutes more.
Cook the rice in 3 cups of boiling water, covered, for 12 minutes until tender, and serve the curry over the top with coriander.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C throughout; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork Tacos with Lime Slaw
recipes.summary: Pork shoulder slow-cooks with smoky spices until it shreds, then fills warm tortillas with crunchy lime slaw.
steps: Rub the pork with the paprika, cumin, oregano and salt, then place in the slow cooker with the onion, garlic and orange juice. Cook on low for 8 hours, until it shreds easily.
Shred the pork with two forks and moisten with some of the cooking juices.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and coriander. Serve the pork in warm tortillas with slaw and sour cream.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 75°C and be very tender; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Chickpea and Sweet Potato Curry
recipes.summary: A mild, creamy vegan curry that cooks itself, with sweet potato, chickpeas and spinach.
steps: Put the sweet potato, chickpeas, onion, garlic, curry powder, coconut milk, tomatoes and salt in the slow cooker. Cook on low for 6 hours, until the sweet potato is soft.
Stir through the spinach until wilted.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes until tender, drain and serve with the curry.
notes: Naturally vegan.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Lamb Shoulder with Red Wine and Rosemary
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder braises until the meat falls apart in a rich red wine and rosemary sauce.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil for 8 minutes, until deeply coloured, and place in the slow cooker.

Soften the onion, carrot and garlic in the same pan for 5 minutes, add the wine and bubble for 3 minutes, then add to the cooker with the tomatoes, stock, rosemary and salt. Cook on low for 7 hours, until the meat falls apart.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, mash with the butter and serve under the lamb.
notes: Food safety: cook lamb until very tender and above 75°C; cool leftovers quickly and eat within 3 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Cannellini Cassoulet-Style Pork Sausage Pot
recipes.summary: Pork sausages, cannellini beans and tomato simmer into a thick, hearty casserole.

items: 2 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Brown the sausages in a pan for 6 minutes, then slice them into thick pieces.
Put them in the slow cooker with the beans, tomatoes, onion, carrot, garlic, stock, paprika, thyme and salt. Cook on low for 6 hours, until the vegetables are soft.
Scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.
notes: Food safety: pork sausages must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink; cool leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: Date Night Pan-Seared Steak with Garlic Butter and Asparagus
recipes.summary: Two sirloin steaks seared hard and finished with garlic butter, with crisp asparagus on the side.
steps: Season the steaks and sear in the oil in a very hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium, then add half the butter, garlic and thyme and baste for 1 minute. Rest for 5 minutes.
Cook the asparagus in the remaining butter for 4 minutes, until bright green and just tender.
Slice the steak, spoon over the pan butter and serve with asparagus and lemon.
notes: Food safety: whole cuts of steak can be served medium (63°C) but rest the meat; use a clean plate for cooked steak.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Date Night Creamy Garlic Prawn Linguine
recipes.summary: Plump prawns in a lemony garlic cream sauce over linguine, ready in 25 minutes for two.
steps: Boil the linguine in salted water for 10 minutes, until al dente, and reserve a cup of the water.
Cook the garlic and chilli in the oil for 1 minute, add the prawns and cook for 2 minutes until pink, then add the wine and simmer for 2 minutes.
Stir in the cream, lemon zest and juice, toss through the pasta with a splash of pasta water and finish with parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque all the way through; eat leftovers within 1 day.
Contains gluten, crustacean shellfish and milk.

recipes.title: Date Night Mushroom and Thyme Risotto for Two
recipes.summary: A creamy mushroom risotto finished with parmesan and a little butter, made in one pan.
steps: Cook the mushrooms in the oil in a wide pan for 6 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the butter for 4 minutes, add the rice and stir for 1 minute, then add the wine until absorbed.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 20 minutes until the rice is creamy and tender. Fold in the mushrooms, thyme, parmesan and salt.
notes: Contains milk.

recipes.title: Date Night Pan-Roasted Chicken Breast with White Wine Sauce
recipes.summary: Golden chicken breasts finished in a quick white wine and mustard sauce with green beans.
steps: Season the chicken and sear in the oil for 5 minutes a side until golden, then roast in a 200°C oven for 8 minutes until cooked through. Rest for 3 minutes.
Soften the onion in the butter for 3 minutes, add the wine and stock and reduce for 5 minutes, then stir in the mustard and cream.
Steam the beans for 5 minutes until tender, slice the chicken and serve with the sauce.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains milk and mustard.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: Single-Serve Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.summary: A quick fried rice for one, using leftover cooked rice, a small chicken thigh and frozen veg.
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in half the oil for 4 minutes until cooked through, then push aside.
Scramble the egg in the remaining oil for 1 minute until set, add the garlic, rice and vegetables and fry for 3 minutes until piping hot.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and top with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink and the egg must be set; use rice that was cooled and refrigerated within 1 hour of cooking, and eat leftovers within 1 day.
Contains egg, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: Garlic Butter Gnocchi with Spinach
recipes.summary: Pan-fried gnocchi tossed with garlic, spinach and parmesan in a single frying pan.
steps: Fry the gnocchi in the oil for 5 to 6 minutes, until golden and crisp on the outside.
Add the butter and garlic and cook for 1 minute, then toss through the spinach until wilted.
Season with pepper and finish with parmesan.
notes: Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: One salmon fillet glazed in teriyaki, served over rice with cucumber and edamame.
steps: Pan-fry the salmon in the oil for 3 minutes a side, until golden and just cooked through.
Pour in the soy sauce, mirin and honey and simmer for 1 minute until sticky.
Serve over the rice with edamame and cucumber, topped with sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: cook salmon until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C; eat leftovers cold within 1 day.
Contains fish, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: One-Pan Egg and Tomato Shakshuka
recipes.summary: Two eggs poached in a spiced tomato and capsicum sauce, scooped up with toasted bread.
steps: Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and spices for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes and simmer for 6 minutes until thick.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are as firm as you like.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the toast once the eggs are set.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are completely set, and eat the dish the same day.
Contains egg and gluten.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Thin beef strips and broccoli in a glossy garlic soy sauce, ready in 15 minutes.
steps: Toss the beef with the cornflour. Stir-fry in half the oil over high heat for 2 minutes until browned, then remove.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, add the soy sauce, oyster sauce and water and simmer for 2 minutes until glossy.
Return the beef to heat through and serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: beef strips must be cooked through to 71°C with no pink; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Cooking for One: Creamy Tomato and White Bean Pasta
recipes.summary: A quick vegetarian pasta with white beans, tomato and a spoonful of cream cheese for richness.

items: 1/2 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Boil the penne in salted water for 10 minutes until al dente and drain.
Cook the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 6 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the cream cheese and salt until melted, toss through the pasta and top with basil.
notes: Contains gluten and milk.
